issues.on_page: Grant income 320,550 (General 500, Sales Tax 39,050, Capital Projects 281,000)
issues.issue: No page says who the grantor is. The user's 2026-11-06 ruling says not to guess a grantor, and config/label_synonyms.csv maps 'Grant income' to intergovernmental/state aid. The same applies to detail[27] (500, p22), detail[129] (39,050, p18) and detail[144] (281,000, p20).
The printed label says reimbursement, which could be reimbursements/refunds. It was put in intergovernmental/state aid because the CRA is a component unit. detail[126] (p18) has the same question.

The printed label is just 'Community development'. The Community Betterment rule covers lines labelled betterment or 'Community development/betterment'. Imperial FY2024 puts the same Sales Tax Fund line in economic development, and the statement (p6) counts it in Environment and leisure.

The same label gets different categories in this report: Recreation Fees for Park (detail[61], 16,988) and Pool (detail[76], 38,072), but charges for services/fees for Library. FY2024 does the same split.
'Rental and fees' gets two categories here: Rentals for Library (detail[47], 1,493) and Cemetery Fees for Cemetery. It is a mixed label with no printed breakdown. FY2024 does the same.
No page shows these auditorium sales are rentals. Also, statement line receipts[16] 'Sales' 4,778,265 includes this 51,894 but is categorized Utility Charges (this is flagged in its review note).
